title: Average price per hour
statementMd:
For each airline show the average base price per flight hour (base price divided by duration in hours), rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `name`, `price_per_hour`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT a.name, ROUND(AVG(f.base_price / (f.duration_min / 60.0)), 2) AS price_per_hour FROM flights f JOIN airlines a ON a.code = f.airline_code GROUP BY a.code, a.name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
